name: aws-file-processing
description: Upload, process and query very large documents through AWS S3 without their contents entering the model's context, and drive the Scyne requirements pipeline as tracked issues.

interface.shortDescription: Run the Scyne pipeline and process huge documents, without filling the context window
interface.longDescription: Ships two MCP servers. The FILE plane provides an upload-process-retrieve workflow for documents up to 5 GiB: files travel directly from the machine into an S3 bucket using an 8 MiB-part multipart upload, and a worker pool converts and chunks them there, so a 2 GB PDF can be questioned while only a few kilobytes ever reach the context window. The WORKSPACE plane is a full front door to the Scyne requirements pipeline — thirty tools covering what the web chat and the scyne CLI can each do: ingesting documents of any size into a project, starting and revising every stage, approving gates, and reporting spend and audit. A stage started from Claude Code becomes the SAME tracked issue the chatbot creates, visible in the console, in Spend and in Actions.
defaultPrompt: Upload a large document to S3, process it into page-mapped chunks, and answer my questions about it using only the passages that matter.
Run the capability map for my project and tell me when it needs approving.
